messages:
alex: Kicking off intake for vesta-7b-int8 bring-up. Goal: evaluate quantized variant for Hosted + Dedicated + Private. Need a deployment + canary playbook, gating thresholds for quality & perf, and fallback policies. Timeline: prototype + eval this week, canary next week.

maria: Thanks — quick prioritization: 1) correctness/regression vs current prod (vanguard-6b) on our eval sets; 2) latency/p95 on each deployment mode; 3) cost per 1M tokens; 4) stability under sustained load.

alex: Proposed gating thresholds: accuracy delta <= 1.5% absolute on core evals, hallucination rate not worse than prod by >2pts, p95 latency <= 200ms hosted (concurrent users sim), <= 150ms dedicated, inference error rate < 0.5%. Any objections?

sanjay: Sounds reasonable. A couple infra items: - we should reserve a small Dedicated pool (1-2 cards) for canary runs so we can reproduce perf. - For Hosted canary, we can route 1% traffic first -> 5% -> 20% with automated rollback on metric breach. - Fallback plan: route requests to vesta-7b-fp16 if int8 strawman breaches quality or OOM.

maria: Add eval gating: run the full prompt suite (prod-critical prompts + random sample) and a short synthetic adversarial set. We’ll require both: metric pass and no high-severity failure examples (e.g., leaked PII, toxic output).

alex: Draft checklist for bring-up (shareable):
```
1) Model artifact validation: checksums, config (seq_len, kv_cache), tokenizer compatibility.
2) Quantization test: run post-training/quant-aware quant tests; compare perplexity and logits on 1000 samples.
3) Offline eval: run full eval harness (prod-critical + adversarial). Record metrics.
4) Perf bench: p50/p95/p99 traces on hosted/dedicated sim at target concurrency.
5) Memory/oom sweeps: long-run steady-state at peak seq len.
6) Canary plan: deploy canary with 1% traffic -> monitor 24h -> ramp per policy.
7) Rollback triggers: quality delta > threshold, latency SLO breach, error rate spike, OOM.
8) Fallback: auto-route to fp16 variant and disable batching/kv-cache if needed.
9) Post-rollout: 72h stability window + daily regression checks for 7 days.
```

maria: Add acceptance criteria lines to checklist: include exact eval script commit sha and seed, and mention that quantization parameters must be recorded in model metadata. Also require a smoke test endpoint that returns deterministic output for a probe prompt.

sanjay: For canary monitoring, here's what we need on the dashboard: token-level cost, p95 latency, request success rate, top 10 error traces, and sample outputs flagged by quality classifier. Alerting: page when error rate >0.5% for 5m or p95 > threshold for 10m.

emily: For Hosted customers we must also confirm privacy handling: no logging of raw prompts for private plan; for Hosted, redact PII and include opt-out flag. Also confirm KMS keys for Private deployment.

alex: Ops notes for rollout commands (internal):
```
# promote artifact to canary repo
rcli model promote --model vesta-7b-int8 --tag canary --checksum sha256:abcd...
# create canary route 1%
platform route create --model vesta-7b-int8 --route canary --weight 0.01 --fallback vesta-7b-fp16
# monitor script (local)
./monitor_canary.sh --route canary --duration 24h --metrics latency,error_rate,quality_delta
```

ci-bot: Scheduled canary job 1762349200: canary runs queued on Dedicated pool d-pool-small (1xA10G). Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/1762349200

alex: Awesome — I’ll attach the eval harness results when the offline run finishes. For rollouts, let's lock the canary escalation policy to only be triggable by eng-ml + eng-sre until we hit 20% traffic. @sanjay can you set that in the routing policy?

sanjay: Yep — setting escalation policy now. Also prepping warm cache priming script to reduce cold-start noise. Will post results from 1% run.

maria: Plan looks good. If offline metrics pass, priority is to do a Hosted micro-canary (1%) first, then Dedicated canary on our reserved pool, then offer Private package to pilot customer A.

alex: Timeline recap: offline eval & perf today (1762348901), canary runs scheduled (1762349200), decision checkpoint next Tue 1762350000. Thanks all. :thumbsup: (reacts :eyes:)
